text_block_list.text: Fortunately, her symptoms were mild, allowing Sakura Laurel to run once again. However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I found a well-ventilated spot.
I'll make good use of the ice pack you prepared for me!
...The Derby is a special race.

There was also the possibility
that she wouldn't make it in time for that once-in-a-lifetime race.

Even if my life depended on it, there's no way
I could say something as irresponsible as
"Let's enter if your legs are feeling good."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like someone's already here.

Biwa Hayahide is a Senior-class Umamusume
and the older sister of Narita Brian.

And in races, she's an incredibly consistent contender
who has never finished below 3rd place.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you here to watch Narita Brian too?
On the track Biwa Hayahide was pointing to, Narita Brian was running.
...With sturdy legs that can train late into the night, unlike Sakura Laurel's.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It's a run that completely captivates you.
Though it's far too wild to call a model example.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a truly sinful little beast.
I can certainly see why she gains more fans.
choice_data_list: I'm not a fan, I'm your rival!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh.
My apologies for that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is the Umamusume you train
in the Classic Class, just like Brian?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Hehe, brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I was just an inexperienced girl in the Classic class myself.
Around Derby time, I was troubled by so many doubts.
choice_data_list: Even someone as strong as you has things to worry about?
Even someone as strong as you has things to worry about?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But judging by your tone,
it seems you two have your own troubles as well.
The hand extended by Biwa Hayahide might be a sign that it's okay to consult her.

Is it right to reveal Sakura Laurel's worries
in her absence?
After hesitating and considering how much I could share—
choice_data_list: It's not about us, it's about a friend of mine, but...
It's not about us, it's about a friend of mine, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see. So your friend's trainee wanted to run in the Derby with everything she had and defeat Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then the answer is simple.
—Do not avert your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Turning away won't change the outcome.
It will only leave behind the regret of not choosing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...And besides.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume in the eye of the storm
doesn't seem to understand Brian yet, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Her running is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian continues to grow,
feeding on the sheer passion
of the Umamusume present on the track.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—And she seeks to reach beyond
the very concept of strength that we know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If that Umamusume considers that to be admiration,
then she ought to know her true nature.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If you wish to surpass the "strongest," just as I do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, are you prepared
to be hated by your trainee?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Working as a trainer is a difficult business.
Because sometimes you must be an ally to an Umamusume's feelings...
and other times, you must become their adversary.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, merely catering to outward emotions doesn't necessarily protect what's truly at the core of their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Deep down, didn't you realize that you had to tell them?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...That's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "You're the ones who will become rivals to my sister, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...What's the matter?
Calling me out at this hour...
choice_data_list: Actually, there's something I want to talk to you about

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "If I ever look like I'm giving in to the pain or fear, please give me a good slap on the back and tell me to chase my ideal run!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...What did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! Umm, regarding that matter,
I've already—
choice_data_list: You can hate me after you hear this.
You can hate me after you hear this.

text_block_list.text:
Now, let us show Sakura Laurel the way forward.
The choices to come.
About the Japan Derby—
